subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Marine biologists classify whales based on their feeding methods.
• Baleen whales feed by filtering small organisms through specialized plates.
• They account for roughly 15 species of whales.
• Toothed whales hunt and capture prey using their teeth.
• They account for roughly 85 species of whales.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference between baleen whales and toothed whales. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Marine biologists classify whales into types, two of which are baleen whales and toothed whales.
choices.B: Marine biologists consider a whale's feeding method (such as whether the whale filters food or hunts prey) when classifying it.
choices.C: Roughly 85 species of whales are classified as toothed whales; another number of species is classified as baleen whales.
choices.D: Baleen whales feed by filtering small organisms through specialized plates, whereas toothed whales hunt and capture prey using their teeth.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a difference between baleen whales and toothed whales, noting that baleen whales feed by filtering small organisms through specialized plates, while toothed whales hunt and capture prey using their teeth.
